quarterly_data.signal: Deck strategy: EUV mask blanks have advanced into the mass-production (HVM) preparation phase; the company has a strategic cooperation with a leading global semiconductor manufacturer (not named) and product qualification is under way toward HVM readiness, after which full-scale mass production and supply capabilities will be expanded; it has supplied EUV mask-blank samples for evaluation from the Yongin EUV Center (completed Oct. 2025), which the deck places near its key customer and the Yongin semiconductor cluster. In DUV/FPD mask blanks it targets demand from legacy-node foundry fab expansions in China (multi-patterning raising photomask use) and new display fabs, is raising the share of high-end mask blanks to improve mix and margins, and is expanding supply for OLED adoption in mobile, IT and automotive panels.
